## 3. Requirements

### REQ-SYS-001: Straight key input

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Statement | The radio shall key the transmitter within 5 ms of contact closure on a straight key connected to the key jack. |
| Rationale | SI-018 core requirement; 5 ms keeps element timing imperceptible at 50 WPM (ADR-001). |
| Verification method | Test |
| Verification note | HostUnit debounce timeline; emulator scenario with GPIO stimulus; bench with dummy load. |
| Status | Active |
| Priority | KDR |
| Parent | - |
| Children | REQ-SW-KEYER-001 |
| Sources | SI-018, NGO-001, OPS-001 |
| Hazards | HZ-001 |
| Tags | revA |

### REQ-SYS-002: Iambic paddle input

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Statement | The radio shall form Morse elements from iambic paddles with a built-in keyer at any speed from 5 WPM to 50 WPM. |
| Rationale | SI-018 core requirement; the speed range 5 to 50 WPM is the owner's accepted range (SI-033). |
| Verification method | Test |
| Status | Active |
| Priority | KDR |

### REQ-SYS-005: Battery endurance

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Statement | The radio shall operate for 8 (TBR) hours at a 1:9 transmit-to-receive ratio on one charge of its cells. |

### REQ-SYS-006: RF exposure at the operating position

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Statement | The radio shall produce a power density of at most 1.0 mW per square centimeter at 20 cm from the antenna at 5 W output. |
| Rationale | SI-003 and the RF exposure hazard HZ-002; the value is the controlled-environment limit at 146 MHz. |
| Verification method | Analysis |
| Verification note | Analysis accepted per RSK-001: no field-strength meter is available; OET Bulletin 65 far-field calculation with the antenna gain from the datasheet. |
